In B2B event production, a signed contract is the easiest part of the relationship.

The real test comes at 11pm the night before a 400-person conference — when a keynote cancels, a transfer goes missing, or the AV setup doesn't match the rider. That's the moment that determines whether a client calls you again.

After 16 years and 1,500+ events across 130+ destinations, the metric we're most proud of isn't scale. It's the ratio of returning clients to first-time clients.

If you're a senior HR, marketing or sales leader evaluating partners for a high-stakes event in 2025 or 2026 — we're happy to talk specifics. No pitch deck required.
